_source: MCP-verified 2026-11-16 on beta.tailorbird.com (owner session): Manage Organization → Roles tab → Add role → "Create role" drawer. Baseline compared by TC568 (tests/TC35_UnitTracker.spec.js). To accept an intended product change, re-run TC568 with UPDATE_ROLE_PERMISSIONS_BASELINE=1 and review the diff of this file.

permissions.name: Delete Approval Templates
permissions.description: Allows users to delete Approval Templates

permissions.name: Create & Manage Approval Templates
permissions.description: Allows users to create and manage Approval Templates

permissions.name: Amenity Name - Edit
permissions.description: Allows users to edit amenity names during amenity name approvals

permissions.name: Create and Manage Bids
permissions.description: Allow users to create and manage bids

permissions.name: Delete Bids
permissions.description: Allow users to delete bids

permissions.name: Edit Manage Versions
permissions.description: Allows users to edit the names or metadata of budget versions.

permissions.name: Delete Manage Versions
permissions.description: Enables the removal of specific budget versions from a property.

permissions.name: Mark Version Active
permissions.description: Allows users to set a specific budget version as the current active budget.

permissions.name: Delete Revision Row
permissions.description: Grants the ability to delete rows or items during a budget revision.

permissions.name: Adjustment and Reallocation
permissions.description: Permission to adjust funds and reallocate amounts between budget items.

permissions.name: Edit Revision
permissions.description: Allows editing of existing line items while a budget is under revision.

permissions.name: Add Budget Revision Line Item
permissions.description: Enables adding new line items during the budget revision process.

permissions.name: Revise Budget
permissions.description: Grants permission to initiate a revision of the existing property budget.

permissions.name: Upload Document in Revision
permissions.description: Allows uploading supporting documentation for budget revisions.

permissions.name: Edit Revision Documents
permissions.description: Allows editing metadata for documents attached to budget revisions.

permissions.name: Delete Document in Revision Documents
permissions.description: Grants permission to delete documents tied to budget revisions.

permissions.name: Create and Manage
permissions.description: Allow users to create and manage change orders

permissions.name: Delete
permissions.description: Allow users to delete change orders

permissions.name: Create and Manage Contracts & POs
permissions.description: Allow users to create and manage contracts and POs

permissions.name: Void/Cancel Contracts
permissions.description: Allow users to void or cancel contracts

permissions.name: Delete Invoice
permissions.description: Grants the ability to delete an invoice from the system.

permissions.name: Create and Manage Invoices
permissions.description: Allow users to create and manage invoices

permissions.name: Create Job
permissions.description: Allows users to create new jobs within a property.

permissions.name: Delete Job
permissions.description: Grants the ability to permanently delete a job from the property.

permissions.name: Reopen Job
permissions.description: Allows users to reopen a Complete/Closed job.

permissions.name: Complete/Close Job
permissions.description: Allows users to mark a job as Complete/Closed.

permissions.name: IT & IAM Setup
permissions.description: Allows users to open IT & IAM Setup for domain verification, SSO, and directory sync.

permissions.name: Create Project
permissions.description: Allows users to create a new project within a property.

permissions.name: Delete Project
permissions.description: Grants the ability to permanently delete projects from a property.

permissions.name: Edit Data inline
permissions.description: Enables inline editing of property details like address and unit count directly in the table.

permissions.name: Create Property
permissions.description: Allows users to create a new property record within the organization.

permissions.name: Delete Property
permissions.description: Provides the ability to permanently remove a property from the system.

permissions.name: Edit Locations
permissions.description: Enables updating details for existing property locations and units.

permissions.name: Takeoff Edit Fields
permissions.description: Allows editing of specific data fields within property takeoffs.

permissions.name: Export Asset Viewer Views
permissions.description: Enables exporting specific views and data from the Asset Viewer tool.

permissions.name: Create Draw
permissions.description: Allows users to create draw reports for a property.

permissions.name: Create & Update Column
permissions.description: Allows users to create and update custom table columns.

permissions.name: Delete Column
permissions.description: Allows users to delete custom table columns.

permissions.name: Reorder Columns
permissions.description: Allows users to save a table's column order for everyone in the organization.

permissions.name: Create & Update Row Sections
permissions.description: Allows users to create and update row sections.

permissions.name: Delete Row Sections
permissions.description: Allows users to delete row sections.

permissions.name: Move Rows to Sections
permissions.description: Allows users to move rows between sections.

permissions.name: Edit Status & Dates
permissions.description: Allows users to edit status, reno start date and reno end date on the Unit Tracker.

permissions.name: Admin-Edit Lease Fields
permissions.description: Allows users to overwrite an already-synced Move-Out, Prior Rent, Move-In or Current Rent value on the Unit Tracker, and to re-pull a record from the PMS.
